Current queue review,20October2026 (bd-01M5E33RPWBT8NAGKCKJMMN6FN)

Completeness: bounded_child_locally_qualified_not_landed.
Assessment: Retain exact child qualifications; later parent integration/readout evidence is separate and broader. No new study read performed here.
Staleness: Review is correct. Adapter note saying doing is superseded by actual review state and later parent handoff.
Remaining / next action: Consume the later parent54cf998b/fd5e3fe9 qualification and integrate the instrument branch within its own scope; close child only after actual landing.
Audit: docs/refactor/evidence/queue-review-20261020/README.md. This planning review does not grant publication, study-read or integration authority.

--- Preserved prior scope, acceptance and history ---

Parent: bd-01M2TAAQNS7RCCBBM8WFFZF6ZZ. Tag reality-check-20261015. Implement the remaining pure adapter and exact-rational JSON transport for the frozen historical comparison. The parent retains guarded I/O, declarations, source/exposure bindings, actual support/capture admission and scientific interpretation. No real data, model, gold, network, full gate or commits by a helper.

Own only tools/recall-study/historical_readout_adapter.py and tests/test_historical_readout_adapter.py. Reuse historical_risk_readout.py and fixed_support_risk.py unchanged. One writer per scope; preserve all other work. API build_readout(manifest, support, captures, *, config), where captures is the already validated h.read_historical()['arms'] mapping: exact two arms -> exact manifest participants -> {'partition':..., 'scores': tuple of derived decision-score rows}. No file reader or admission capability.

The complete fixed support is now committed/reviewed at f00f8d96dc2780f7d958b5146f3250d8f7509e9b: canonical digest32a55c54001036ed10eda6114792a9de44be7accbf216c8599e01afba5f8f746; actual output remains private. Do not read it for implementation/testing. Parent will separately pin/read that exact support in the future guarded entry.

Acceptance:
1. Before arithmetic, join every participant and ordered unit ID across manifest, complete support rows and both complete capture arms. Refuse missing/extra/duplicate/reordered units, foreign people, partition disagreement and malformed score status/value or scene types. No eligibility from predictions. Original partitions are development/untouchedTest; all are previously exposed. Parent verifies physical hashes, source/gold/rule identities and ontology context; this pure layer verifies its inventory relation.
2. Analyze fixed development, untouchedTest and all strata; exact-scene primary and within-one secondary. Keep every observation and exclusion in accounting. Only participants with positive frozen gold eligibility enter localization means; retain zero-eligible people with explicit NoEligibleGoldUnits accounting. Empty eligible stratum is structured unavailable, never a fabricated zero.
3. Correctness comes exclusively from emittedScene versus frozen goldScene, with missing emitted scene incorrect. assignedScene, posterior choice, origin and score availability never determine correctness/eligibility. Preserve all three ownAnchorMass/emittedSceneMass/leafMass series; available zero is rankable, Missing/NotApplicable maps to Outcome(...,None), never zero. Permit only validated statuses Available(value finite>=0), Missing(reason), NotApplicable(reason); origins RawSourceMaximum/GroupConstrained/RequestedFill. Retain score-status/reason and origin counts, per arm/person and stratum, with observation/eligible denominators.
4. Delegate arithmetic to the independently reviewed summarize API with the same config for both outcomes. Preserve complete output, exact Fractions, bootstrap matrix digests and fixed participant domains. All three series, pointwise intervals, common/full/native areas, conditional references, paired differences and LOO are already its responsibility. No winner selection, recalibration or new threshold.
5. Descriptive absolute scene-index distance only among emitted labels: report per-person median and pooled label median, labelled/eligible counts and exact coverage, no inference or extra confidence intervals. Missing decisions remain in accuracy denominators even though distance is unavailable.
6. to_jsonable(value): preserve Fraction VALUES exactly as {'numerator': int, 'denominator': positive int}; do not cast to float. For a dictionary whose keys are all Fraction requested coverages, encode a sorted array of {'requestedCoverage': encoded Fraction, 'summary': encoded value}, avoiding string-key collisions or lexical order. Ordinary mappings require string keys, tuples/lists become arrays, None/bool/int/finite float/string remain; refuse unsupported/nonfinite values. Document this transport, including nested LOO coverage arrays. No JSON/file I/O inside the module.
7. Independent synthetic courts: assignedScene differs from emittedScene (must not flatter correctness); missing decision incorrect; fill with unavailable own score stays missing, actual zero stays available; extra/missing/reordered units fail before summarize; one zero-eligible participant remains accounted but does not distort means; strata/outcomes identical bootstrap digest for the same participant inventory; exact rational/negative/repeating/coverage-array transport preserves None versus zero and rejects nonfinite/unsupported keys; descriptive median/coverage correct by hand. Small synthetic fixtures only, ~40 bootstrap resamples. Parent handles compiling mutations and independent exact-SHA review before actual use.

No actual historical readout is authorized merely by this implementation. Remaining composite I/O will require a new prior-read declaration and qualification; original gold must not be reopened for comparison. This is descriptive correction of later shipped-vs-monofill analysis, not original shipped-vs-unblended preregistration or fresh confirmation.
